auth.label: MCP Token
auth.description: Copy your MCP Token from the XYDC platform console for Authorization bearer authentication. Follow https://platform.xydc.com/docs/mcp-access. Use the MCP Token, not a REST API Key.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current XYDC MCP tool with JSON arguments matching its live schema. Calls may consume Credits. Each successful generate_category_insight_resource call costs 500 Credits, including existing resources; reuse the returned resource and do not blindly retry generation. Connector waits at most 55 seconds for generation. A timeout does not confirm upstream cancellation or prevent charges; the result may be unknown. Do not automatically retry generation after a timeout.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current XYDC MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the XYDC MCP tool.

actions.name: generate_category_insight_resource
actions.description: Generate a category insight resource for a user-confirmed marketplace and category. XYDC waits up to five minutes and rebuilds failed resources internally. Each independent successful call costs 500 Credits, including existing-resource hits. Reuse resourceId for subsequent queries; do not blindly retry. Connector waits at most 55 seconds for generation. A timeout does not confirm upstream cancellation or prevent charges; the result may be unknown. Do not automatically retry generation after a timeout. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

categoryId.description: The category ID confirmed by the user.

country.description: The Amazon marketplace explicitly selected by the user, such as US, UK or DE. Do not assume a marketplace.

user_task.description: Optional original user request for the current task, preserving the wording, subjects, dates and constraints after redacting sensitive information. Keep it consistent within the same task; do not replace it with a subtask, inferred plan or summary. actions.name: read_category_insight_guide
actions.description: Read the official XYDC category insight workflow before a category analysis: marketplace and category confirmation, resource generation, reuse, reporting periods, pagination and Credits.

actions.name: report_missing_xiyou_capability
actions.description: Submit a missing-capability feedback event to XYDC when requested by the user. This records product feedback, not Amazon data, and should not be used for ordinary input errors. Redact sensitive information before submission.

current_blocker.description: Why current tools cannot meet the need or require an impractical tool chain. Do not include the original user prompt.

intent_summary.description: Optional purpose of this tool call and how it helps the current task. Describe only this step, without repeating the complete task, analysis plan or conclusions. Redact sensitive information before sending.

missing_capability.description: The missing XYDC capability: describe the missing analysis, data or automation steps.

suggested_tool_name.description: Suggested name for a future tool.

tried_tools.description: Names of MCP tools already tried without meeting the need.

user_task.description: Optional original user request for the current task, preserving the wording, subjects, dates and constraints after redacting sensitive information. Keep it consistent within the same task; do not replace it with a subtask, inferred plan or summary. Preserve public ASINs, keywords, marketplaces and dates; redact account details, contacts, credentials and sensitive URL parameters before sending to XYDC.

result.description: Capability feedback confirmation returned by XYDC.

actions.name: search_market_insight_categories
actions.description: Search Amazon categories by keyword or ASIN, returning paths, representative-ASIN counts, availability and existing translations. Free. Present candidates and obtain user confirmation before generating a category resource, even for one candidate. Read xydc_mcp.read_category_insight_guide before the first category insight task.

country.description: The Amazon marketplace explicitly selected by the user, such as US, UK or DE. Do not assume a marketplace.
